g.text: AGREED · Machine package (Swift) · the Machine server's core · no app, macOS or provider dependency

text.tspan: Desktop provider · the server's first plugin (Swift)
remainders: its own; a window reference carries pid, window number and title (Modaliser's fallback)
relations: application · windows · … · commands: focus · openUrl · …
Reference: a URI string machine://<provider>/<opaque remainder> · root = empty remainder · branded in TypeScript
Snapshot { items: [ { ref, fields } ] } · one provider resolution per query
MachineError (JSON across the bridge): unknownProvider · unknownRelation · unknownCommand
register(provider) · routes by the URI's authority · reads nothing else
no cache · no refresh · no retry
name · query(target, relation, args) · execute(target, command, args)
→ one item: the leader's application, from the interaction context
→ items: each window's ref and fields (title, bounds …)
→ result, or unavailable if the window has gone
